summary: This model represents the internal gear assembly of a mechanical timepiece. It is used to demonstrate how energy is transferred from a power source to the hands of a clock. A series of interlocking gears regulates the release of energy to ensure precise timekeeping. This complex system is essential for understanding traditional horological engineering.
